sys_atf_test.description: Tests the complete procurement lifecycle: creates a supplier, places a procurement order, receives materials, performs a quality check, creates a procurement report with quality/delivery/quantity scores, then validates that the calc-report-score business rule computed overall_score as the average of the three scores. Next, inserts a supplier rating referencing the report and validates that the recalc-supplier-score business rule updated the supplier cumulative_score, total_ratings, and total_orders. Cleans up all records in reverse order.
sys_atf_test.name: Procurement E2E Lifecycle Test
